title: North and South Pontotoc will play for different football region titles in 2027
excerpt: North keeps New Albany as a region rival. South draws four new opponents, while Pontotoc keeps its entire Class 5A group.
locality: North Pontotoc in Ecru, South Pontotoc and Pontotoc High School in Pontotoc County, Mississippi.

facts.statement: North Pontotoc’s 22–15 football win at South Pontotoc on Oct. 23 counted in the Class 4A Region 1 standings for both teams. Starting in 2027, a meeting between the county rivals would be a nonregion game. The Mississippi High School Activities Association placed North in Region 2 and South in Region 4 for the 2027–29 cycle.

paragraphs.text: North Pontotoc’s 22–15 football win at South Pontotoc on Oct. 23 counted in the Class 4A Region 1 standings for both teams. Starting in 2027, a meeting between the county rivals would be a nonregion game. The Mississippi High School Activities Association placed North in Region 2 and South in Region 4 for the 2027–29 cycle.

New Albany is the one familiar region opponent for North. The Bulldogs and Vikings move together, joining Byhalia, Clarksdale and Senatobia. Corinth and Tishomingo County, two other members of North’s old group, stay in Region 1.

South gets an entirely different group. Its four region opponents will be Amory, Houston, Louisville and Shannon. That replaces a schedule of region games against North Pontotoc, New Albany, Corinth and Tishomingo County. The association’s list sets the groups. It leaves game dates and any future North–South nonregion matchup to the schools’ schedules.

Pontotoc High School has continuity in Class 5A. Caledonia, Columbus, Lafayette, New Hope and West Point all remain with the Warriors in Region 1. Of the three county teams, Pontotoc is the only one that keeps every region opponent.
